title: UserAssist program execution history
whyItMatters: This key records which GUI programs a user ran and how often. It shows applications the person used on this machine.
notes: ROT13-encoded value names are not decoded. Only key, value and subkey counts are reported; registry last-write time is unavailable.

steps: Only if you are not doing the full reset at the end of this plan, and you are comfortable with Registry Editor:
Open Registry Editor and expand the key named in the plan.
Delete the GUID subkeys under it, then close Registry Editor.
cleanup.risk: Removes the record of which programs this account ran and how often. Programs still installed keep working normally.
